_status: PROPOSED KEY — not read by the current frontend. src/data/documentReadings.ts builds the wizard's 'What we read from your documents' panel and the step-4 'Found in your documents' metrics from a built-in pool picked by a hash of the filename. To show Keolis content, the team would read this key (by uploaded filename) and fall back to the built-in pool for any other file.
shape: Mirrors MetricDefinition in documentReadings.ts: name, purpose, description, usedFor, note, query, question, priority; plus one context line per file.

Keolis_Valmont_BRD_Fleet_Infrastructure_.context: Renewal projects are keyed by project code (P-VM-nnn); a need without a project is keyed N-VM-nnn.

definitions.name: Forecast Total Project Cost
definitions.purpose: is the headline figure of the monthly investment review and the number the authority's quarterly PPI review is judged against
definitions.description: Posted actuals plus valid uninvoiced accruals plus the forecast cost to complete, per project, EUR HT.
definitions.usedFor: the monthly investment review and the quarterly PPI review.
definitions.note: Accruals are reversed when the invoice arrives; the cost to complete excludes anything already accrued, so nothing is counted twice.
definitions.query:
SELECT p.project_code,
       SUM(t.amount_eur) + COALESCE(a.accrued, 0) + f.ctc_committed_eur + f.ctc_uncommitted_eur + f.contingency_eur AS forecast_total_eur
FROM `ppm`.`project` p
JOIN `fin`.`cost_transaction` t ON t.project_code = p.project_code
LEFT JOIN (SELECT project_code, SUM(amount_eur) AS accrued FROM `fin`.`accrual_line` WHERE matched_invoice IS NULL GROUP BY 1) a ON a.project_code = p.project_code
JOIN `fin`.`forecast_snapshot` f ON f.project_code = p.project_code AND f.scenario = 'Working'
GROUP BY p.project_code, a.accrued, f.ctc_committed_eur, f.ctc_uncommitted_eur, f.contingency_eur;
definitions.question: Which renewal projects are forecasting above their approved budget, and by how much?

definitions.name: Operator Exposure
definitions.purpose: is what the Directrice générale reports to Keolis France — the part of the renewal programme Keolis Valmont itself bears
definitions.description: Costs borne by Keolis Valmont under validated allocations: GER projects in the contract price plus its share of co-funded projects; unresolved exposure shown as a separate scenario.
definitions.note: Never equal to project cost: an authority-funded renewal is not operator exposure, and a disputed recovery is not counted as certain.
definitions.query:
SELECT p.project_code, b.funding_source, SUM(b.amount_eur) AS approved_eur
FROM `ppm`.`project` p
JOIN `fin`.`budget_line` b ON b.project_code = p.project_code
WHERE b.funding_source IN ('GER')
GROUP BY 1, 2;
definitions.question: What is Keolis Valmont's own exposure on the renewal portfolio, separate from the authority's?

definitions.name: Service Availability Margin
definitions.purpose: is checked before any vehicle withdrawal or track closure is approved
definitions.description: Eligible available vehicles minus the peak requirement minus the agreed reserve, by vehicle class and day type.
definitions.usedFor: service planning and the weekly readiness call.
definitions.note: Each unavailable vehicle is subtracted once, from its availability interval — an open work order alone does not make a vehicle unavailable.
definitions.question: Do we have enough vehicles for peak service while assets are withdrawn for renewal?

Keolis_Valmont_User_Stories_Renewal_Deci.context: Every answer states its perspective — operator or authority — before its figures.

definitions.name: Documented Acceptance Completeness
definitions.purpose: decides whether a campaign can be reported as complete to the authority
definitions.description: Verified required acceptance items divided by applicable required items, per project.
definitions.usedFor: handover and the PPI claim evidence pack.
definitions.note: Completeness is not permission to operate; release for duty is issued separately by operations.
definitions.question: Which campaigns are installed but not yet accepted?

definitions.name: Schedule Variance
definitions.purpose: is the first thing the weekly project review looks at
definitions.description: Current forecast milestone date minus the approved baseline milestone date, in working days.
definitions.note: An approved re-baseline is shown as such; a supplier's new date in an email is not a schedule change until the project office records it.
definitions.query:
SELECT s.project_code, s.task_name, s.baseline_finish, s.current_finish,
       DATE_DIFF(s.current_finish, s.baseline_finish, DAY) AS variance_days
FROM `ppm`.`schedule_task` s
WHERE s.current_finish > s.baseline_finish;
definitions.question: Which milestones have slipped against their approved baseline?

definitions.name: Renewal Backlog
definitions.purpose: is presented to the authority at each quarterly PPI review
definitions.description: Validated intervention needs not yet completed, by status: unfunded, option study, deferred, approved.
definitions.usedFor: the quarterly PPI review and the annual renewal programme.
definitions.note: Overlapping options for the same need are counted once; safety and mandatory needs are flagged and cannot be traded away by a score.
definitions.query:
SELECT n.status, COUNT(*) AS needs, SUM(n.estimate_eur) AS estimate_eur
FROM `ppm`.`intervention_need` n
WHERE n.status <> 'Approved'
GROUP BY n.status;
definitions.question: Which assets must be renewed, and which needs are still unfunded?

Keolis_Valmont_Metrics_Definitions_v1.do.context: Money is EUR, excluding VAT (HT), at the posting date; forecast rounds are R1 (April), R2 (July), R3 (October).

definitions.name: Approved Funding Gap
definitions.purpose: is escalated to the authority when it exceeds €250,000 on a project
definitions.description: Forecast fundable expenditure minus applicable approved funding, per PPI project.
definitions.note: Scope, caps and co-funding rules apply; costs the convention does not cover are labelled separately rather than netted.
definitions.query:
SELECT f.project_code, SUM(f.ctc_committed_eur + f.ctc_uncommitted_eur) AS remaining_eur
FROM `fin`.`forecast_snapshot` f
WHERE f.scenario = 'Working'
GROUP BY 1;
definitions.question: Where does the forecast exceed the funding the authority has approved?

definitions.name: Failure Frequency
definitions.purpose: is how the maintenance team argues for renewal ahead of the contractual replacement date
definitions.description: Relevant heavy-component failures per 100,000 km, by vehicle series.
definitions.note: Months with a meter reset are excluded; the peer group is the same vehicle class.
definitions.query:
SELECT a.model, COUNT(f.failure_id) / (SUM(u.distance_km) / 100000) AS failures_per_100k_km
FROM `eam`.`failure_event` f
JOIN `eam`.`asset_register` a ON a.asset_id = f.asset_id
JOIN `eam`.`usage_monthly` u ON u.asset_id = f.asset_id AND u.meter_reset_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY a.model;
definitions.question: Which vehicle series fail most often, per kilometre run?

definitions.name: Open Commitment
definitions.purpose: is reconciled with procurement at every month-end close
definitions.description: Ordered value less received and cancelled value, per PO line, at the line's valuation basis.
definitions.note: Unpaid invoices are not future work; a supplier's revised promise does not change the commitment.
definitions.question: How much is committed on each project but not yet received?
